hints.title: Middle Row Pivot
hints.text: Fix the row for the middle rook. The other two rooks must then come from preceding rows and succeeding rows respectively.

hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Merging
hints.text: Precompute prefix top-three candidates for rows before r and suffix top-three candidates for rows after r.

hints.title: Constant-Time Middle Sweep
hints.text: For each middle row r, evaluate 3 * 3 * 3 = 27 combinations using prefix[r-1] and suffix[r+1], running in linear time O(m).

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Prefix and suffix merging reduces 3-row exploration to O(m).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses middle element pivoting with prefix and suffix extrema.
